project.name: AI Leverage Library
project.purpose: A Git-native, evidence-aware library of reproducible AI techniques organized by outcome rather than provider.
project.primaryUser: Practitioners and AI agents seeking reproducible, authority-bounded AI workflows
project.problemSolved: Useful AI workflows are commonly scattered across prompts, demonstrations, and tribal knowledge without reproducible verification or explicit human authority boundaries.
project.stage: 0.1.0 repository scaffold with one seed technique, tested experiment intake, two accepted-with-limitations bounded trial results; product use and organizational value are UNVERIFIED
project.deploymentTarget: UNVERIFIED - a static documentation site or PWA is specified, but no provider or deployment configuration exists

goals.statement: Maintain portable technique cards, catalogs, and evidence contracts that fail visibly when their structural claims drift.
Enable a practitioner or agent to find, apply, and verify an appropriate technique without hidden context.
Make technique publication and lifecycle promotion reproducible, reviewable, and resistant to evidence inflation.
Demonstrate that the library improves real AI-assisted work through retained outcome evidence.

decisions.summary: Technique cards are canonical; catalogs are derived navigation.
Organize techniques by outcomes rather than vendors or models.
Evidence levels and human authority gates constrain lifecycle promotion.
Keep websites, skills, CLIs, and MCP servers as adapters over a portable content core.
The public repository grants no reuse license unless a separate license is added.
The capability horizon backlog is a non-authoritative option inventory; entries require explicit promotion before they become explorations, roadmap commitments, or canonical capabilities.
Experiment acquisition is preview-first, rejects raw prompt or source flags, and requires explicit retention authorization before writing a proposed record.
Record owner acceptance of PROOF-002 with documented limitations; close only its disposition blocker, preserve existing lifecycle states, and leave the next proof contract awaiting owner selection.

evidence: content/techniques/discover/constraint-compilation.md remains experimental and concept; PROOF-002 retains unresolved independence and access-control limitations

risks.summary: Public visibility may be mistaken for permission to reuse despite the all-rights-reserved license.
Two practitioner artifacts may be mistaken for an accepted reproducible or observed user outcome.

blockers.summary: The retained repetition lacks authorized disposition and resolution of its independence and access-control limitations.
evidence: EXP-20260924-001 produced a materially consistent source-traced result, but runtime identity is unverified and broader filesystem non-access was practitioner-reported rather than technically enforced
blockers.resolutionCondition: An authorized human accepts or rejects PROOF-002 and explicitly decides whether the retained independence and access-control limitations satisfy the proof contract or require a stricter rerun.
blockers.resolution: Repository owner accepted the linked bounded result with its documented limitations on 2026-10-20; unknown runtime identity and non-enforced broader access remain evidence limitations.

blockers.summary: The next proof contract has not been selected or authorized by the owner.
evidence: PROOF-002 is accepted with limitations; no subsequent workflow, pass/fail criteria, reviewer, or execution authority has been selected.
blockers.resolutionCondition: The owner selects and approves a bounded next proof contract, including workflow, evidence requirements, reviewer, and pass/fail conditions.

proofEvents.name: Independent governed use of Constraint Compilation
proofEvents.whyItMatters: It is the smallest event that can distinguish a well-structured technique card from a technique that creates reproducible user value.
prerequisites: Name an authorized reviewer; the bounded searchable-documentation workflow is assigned
Retain the sanitized trial and procedural deviations
acceptanceCriteria: A practitioner who did not author the card follows the canonical workflow
Every compiled constraint traces to supplied evidence
The result preserves scope and authority boundaries
A human reviewer accepts or rejects the output against the documented contract

proofEvents.name: Independent repetition of Constraint Compilation
proofEvents.whyItMatters: PROOF-001 established one accepted-with-limitations bounded trial; repetition tests reproducibility rather than one-run plausibility.
prerequisites: Retain the PROOF-001 artifact and disposition
Retain the validated EXP-20260924-001 protocol, result, and comparison
Require an explicit ruling on the retained practitioner-independence and access-control limitations
acceptanceCriteria: The second practitioner did not author the card
Every compiled constraint traces to supplied evidence
The result preserves scope and authority boundaries
Results and failures are compared with PROOF-001
An authorized human accepts or rejects the repetition

humanDisposition.scope: Bounded artifact accepted with documented independence and access-control limitations; no technique promotion or proven reproducibility.

proofEvents.name: Owner selection of the next bounded proof contract
proofEvents.whyItMatters: The accepted bounded results leave independence, real-world use, and observed value unverified; the owner must select which claim the next event will test.
prerequisites: Retain the qualified PROOF-002 human disposition
Review unresolved evidence limits without promoting the technique
acceptanceCriteria: Owner selects the bounded workflow and claim to test
Owner specifies evidence, reviewer, pass/fail conditions, and stop conditions
